description: Put back every message the thread's last move_thread changed, each in the folder that move found it in. Answers 409, with nothing moved, when the thread has no move to undo (nothingToUndo), a mailbox in it has no folder to put it back in (folderMissing), or that mailbox's mail server can't move messages from one folder to another (moveUnsupported: it lacks IMAP MOVE, so move the thread back in that mailbox's own mail app). A key an owner limited to some mailboxes and agent inboxes changes only the thread's copies in those.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: undo_thread_move
title: Undo a thread's move
